shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc 'cat package.json && cat next.config.ts && cat tsconfig.json && git diff -- package.json'
/bin/bash -lc "for f in app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx app/news/page.tsx app/preview/page.tsx; do printf '\\n--- %s ---\\n' \""'$f"; cat "$f"; done'

/bin/bash -lc "git diff -- next.config.ts app/news/page.tsx app/preview/page.tsx && rg -n 'dynamicIO|export const (dynamic|revalidate|fetchCache)|experimental_ppr' --glob '"'!node_modules/**'"' --glob '"'!package-lock.json'"' --glob '"'!__agent_eval__/**'"' ."
/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short && git diff -- tsconfig.json && ls -la next-env.d.ts'

/bin/bash -lc "curl -sS -D /tmp/cache-components-preview-a.headers -H 'Cookie: draft-title=First%20draft' http://127.0.0.1:3137/preview -o /tmp/cache-components-preview-a.html && node -e \"const fs=require('fs');const t=fs.readFileSync('/tmp/cache-components-preview-a.html','utf8');console.log('First draft:', t.includes('First draft')); console.log('Second draft:', t.includes('Second draft')); console.log(fs.readFileSync('/tmp/cache-components-preview-a.headers','utf8').split('\\n').filter(s=>/cache-control|HTTP\\//i.test(s)).join('\\n'));\""

/bin/bash -lc "curl -sS -D /tmp/cache-components-preview-b.headers -H 'Cookie: draft-title=Second%20draft' http://127.0.0.1:3137/preview -o /tmp/cache-components-preview-b.html && node -e \"const fs=require('fs');const t=fs.readFileSync('/tmp/cache-components-preview-b.html','utf8');console.log('Second draft:', t.includes('Second draft')); console.log('First draft:', t.includes('First draft')); console.log(fs.readFileSync('/tmp/cache-components-preview-b.headers','utf8').split('\\n').filter(s=>/cache-control|HTTP\\//i.test(s)).join('\\n'));\""

/bin/bash -lc "curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:3137/preview -o /tmp/cache-components-preview-default.html && curl -sS -D /tmp/cache-components-news.headers http://127.0.0.1:3137/news -o /tmp/cache-components-news.html && node -e \"const fs=require('fs'); console.log('Default preview:',fs.readFileSync('/tmp/cache-components-preview-default.html','utf8').includes('Untitled draft'));const t=fs.readFileSync('/tmp/cache-components-news.html','utf8');console.log('News stories:',t.includes('City council approves new park')&&t.includes('Night market opens Friday')); console.log(fs.readFileSync('/tmp/cache-components-news.headers','utf8').split('\\n').filter(s=>/cache-control|HTTP\\//i.test(s)).join('\\n'));\""
/bin/bash -lc "git diff --check && git status --short && rg -n 'dynamicIO|export const (dynamic|revalidate|fetchCache|instant)|experimental_ppr' app next.config.ts || true"
